title: Station 9 Lockdown
opening_hook: When the siren began, the station went dark.
summary: An emergency lockdown on Station 9 seals the doors, but the crew discovers something was trapped inside with them.

scenes.title: The Darkening
scenes.narration: When the siren began, the station went dark.
scenes.visual_description: A lone survivor in a shadowy concrete bunker illuminated by the amber glow of failing instrument terminals.
scenes.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim amber emergency glow with heavy shadows

scenes.title: The Sealed Hatch
scenes.narration: We locked the blast doors, but we were not alone.
scenes.visual_description: Massive reinforced iron blast door sealed shut under flashing red strobe lights in an industrial hallway.
